rationale: Main package default EP stays DirectML (7.4-11x over CPU, no CUDA runtime, covers NVIDIA/AMD/Intel).
CUDA is genuinely needed only for manga-ocr (DML 97.87ms vs CUDA 23.17ms) and LaMa (DML fails: DmlFusedConv 80070057; CUDA 76.92ms).
Optional CUDA package sizes: ORT-only 2296.0 MB / with torch 7005.8 MB (both within AD-002 <=8GB budget), but no user evidence at 0.1.0 justifies the extra build/sign/release channel now.
Mo torch-only model exists, so a thin ORT-only CUDA package (option B) remains available if demand appears.
trigger_conditions: >=3 NVIDIA users report OCR/inpaint performance or quality bottlenecks
inpaint quality becomes user-visible issue requiring LaMa-class model
product reaches 1.0 commercial distribution and needs a high-performance variant
future INFER re-measurement shows CUDA advantage on the detection chain

alternatives.option_b: Thin ORT-CUDA package (~2.3GB, no torch), user-supplied CUDA/cuDNN runtime, separate download
alternatives.option_c: Full torch package (~7.0GB) - not recommended (no torch-only model)

followup: If triggered: release CUDA-ORT-PACKAGE-1 (build/package/sign/docs/tests), est. 2-3 dev-days.
